mentions.note: Tipton H.; first in the International cross-country at Ayr
in the white-jerseyed team ("our boys"); took the lead on the second lap

mentions.h: A Review of the Winter Season's Final Events.
mentions.note: of Tipton; won the National, his first after 10 years of trying
won Salisbury invitation 15 miles in 1.22.05; described as "our old Tipton friend" (club not stated)
first man to score 4 wins; 12 appearances; individual winner 1933 and 1939
won 1946 National cross-country at Leamington Spa
